reviewProcess.lockCondition: Visual Master analysis is locked for production planning. Full design completion still requires representative ecology calibration, live Figma implementation and final QA.

representativeEcologyCalibration.passBehavior: Record evidence and stop Phase A. Do not continue to section headers/photo assembly in the same run.

alphaPolicy.fallback: If direct alpha yields checkerboard/opaque RGB, immediately switch to one separable flat extraction matte and edge-aware extraction; do not repeat the same failed direct-alpha path.
alphaPolicy.rule: Flowers, leaves, airplane, camera, rings, ribbon tails and curved display lettering require clean antialiased edge alpha on light/mid/dark backgrounds.

chatGeneratedDraft.reason: A ChatGPT header draft was generated before this manifest writeback, violating the manifest-before-production sequence. It may inform visual discussion only; Codex Phase A must execute from the now-updated authority and produce its own tracked production asset/evidence.
